title: Figures 3-4: hand-drawn diagrams of remote regions Ω1 and Ω2 forming a wormhole throat ∂Ω
description: Two hand-drawn sketches. Figure 3 shows two hatched blob-shaped regions labeled Ω1 and Ω2, each containing ∂Ω, separated by a wavy vertical line; caption: "Diagram of a Simultaneous View of Two Remote Compact Regions, Ω1 and Ω2, of Minkowski Space Used to Create the Wormhole Throat ∂Ω (time is suppressed in this diagram)". Figure 4 shows a stippled vertical lens-shaped throat labeled ∂Ω with a small dotted area marked Ω2, as seen by an observer in region Ω1.
